summary:

title: Contract Awarded for Ontario Line Pape Tunnel and Underground Stations​
summary: On August 5, it was announced that Metrolinx has awarded a $4.32 billion contract to construct the easternmost tunnelled portion of Ontario Line 3, Toronto's first new downtown subway in over 50 years. Running under Pape Avenue between the Gerrard Tunnel Portal and the Minton Portal at the Don Valley, the twin 3-kilometre tunnels will also include two new underground stations at both Danforth and Cosburn avenues.
